name: evidence_grade
description: The single evidence-strength scale, E0 strongest through E3 weakest. An absent or null grade is ungraded; a bare claim or human approval does not supply a grade.

definitions.E0: Strongest evidence: an observed effect artifact.
definitions.E1: An authenticated success response to the exploit action itself.
definitions.E2: Strong inference, with configuration and a reachable path shown separately.
definitions.E3: Weakest evidence: error-message or behavioral inference only.

note: No source type, historical assurance label or actor identity implies an evidence grade. Retain unknown legacy grades as null.
